swim.instrument: MRO SHARAD / Mars Odyssey GRS / MRO HiRISE / MGS TES
swim.missingHandling: NoData pixels masked as NaN, not treated as 0.0
swim.limitation: Consistency indices represent remote-sensing agreement, NOT proven water extraction quantities.

meda.parameter: Atmospheric Temperature, Pressure, Ground IR Temperature, Dust Optical Depth
meda.coverage: Jezero Crater Rover Traverse Track (Sol 1553 historical)
meda.missingHandling: Fill values and bad quality flags excluded from medians.
meda.limitation: Valid historical rover surface observations, NOT live weather at the fictional base.

msl_rad.parameter: Surface Absorbed Ionizing Radiation Dose Rate (Si & TEP)
msl_rad.missingHandling: 54 flagged command records excluded; only filtered _f records used.
msl_rad.limitation: Measures physical absorbed dose in detector materials, NOT human biological dose equivalent.

mcs.parameter: Vertical Atmospheric Profiles of Temperature, Pressure, and Dust Opacity
mcs.missingHandling: Limb pointing errors and missing levels filtered.
mcs.limitation: Represents atmospheric layers at altitude, NOT local surface weather.

donki.instrument: CCMC / GOES / SOHO / SDO Satellite Network
donki.parameter: Coronal Mass Ejection Speed & Solar Flare Classifications
donki.unit: km/s, X-ray Flux Class (B, C, M, X)
donki.missingHandling: Empty SEP file acknowledged with 0 records.
donki.limitation: Earth-oriented space weather system; does not calculate Mars astronaut dose.
